items.title: How much phantom stock loss builds up without a transaction?
items.description: Using the exact bug from L3 (a failed order still decrements stock by 1 unit before failing), drag the number of failed orders that occur and watch the naive version's lost stock climb one unit per failure. The transactional version — which rolls back on every failure — stays fixed at zero lost stock no matter how many orders fail; that fixed reference is the whole point of wrapping the decrement and the insert in one transaction.
